{{Short description|Family of German mathematicians}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=February 2026}}

The '''Noether family''' is a family of German mathematicians, whose family name has been given to some of their mathematical contributions:<ref name="Rowe 2024">{{cite journal |last1=Rowe |first1=David E. |title=Remembering Fritz Noether in the Town of Gengenbach |journal=[[The Mathematical Intelligencer]] |date=March 2024 |volume=46 |issue=1 |pages=63–69 |doi=10.1007/s00283-023-10328-9 |author1-link=David E. Rowe |doi-access=free }}</ref>
    
*[[Max Noether]] (1844–1921), father of Emmy and Fritz Noether, 
**[[Emmy Noether]] (1882–1935), professor at the University of Göttingen and at Bryn Mawr College
**[[Fritz Noether]] (1884–1941), professor at the University of Tomsk
***[[Gottfried E. Noether]] (1915–1991), son of Fritz Noether
